title: More Blueprint Trims
description: This Datapack/Resourcepack fixes issues with certain mods armor trims and blueprint trim code
body:
This file requires to be installed both as a resourcepack and as a datapack clientside.

Adds compatibility and fixes with certain mods and the Blueprint trim system, making them properly show when holding a trimmed armor and also making them compatible with Clayworks.

(It is possible that the pack only works if all the mods listed are installed on latest version)

Trims tweaked by this datapack/resourcepack are:

(Collector's Reap)
-Lunar Pearl

(Exquisito)
-Karmotine 
-Popped Chorus Fruit

(Caverns & Chasms)
-Silver
-Necromium
-Spinel
-Living Flesh

(Oreganized)
-Silver
-Lead
-Electrum

(Vanilla Backport)
-Resin Brick
